suggested_fix: No fix needed. The function copies exactly copy_words * BITS_PER_LONG bits of open_fds and close_on_exec and clears the rest up to the new table size. It also handles full_fds_bits correctly: that bitmap has one bit per word of open_fds, so it copies copy_words bits and extends to nwords bits. Using bitmap_copy_and_extend means no stale bits past the copied range are carried into the new table, which avoids the bitmap inconsistency that older byte-based memcpy/memset versions had (e.g. close_range() with CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE). Callers must still make sure copy_words <= fdt_words(ofdt) and copy_words <= nwords.
